full_judgment: 5. As it appears the trial court dismissed the suit on the findings that Kabuliyet Ext. 1 (C) dated 14.12.1955 had no legal validity after 13.12.1955 in view of the provisions of section 75A of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act 1950; the petitioners claimed that they acquired title to the suit land on the basis of their settlement by Nagendra Bala to Sonaullah, the predecessor of the petitioners but could not prove that they possessed the entire suit land; the suit is also bad for non joinder of Abdus Sobhan and Bazlur Rahman in the suit. The lower appellate court dismissed the appeal on the findings that the documents of settlement on the basis of which the petitioners claimed title, being forged, the petitioners did not acquire any title to the suit land; the petitioners not being in possession of the entire suit land are not entitled to a decree for declaration of title to the suit land; the petitioners by amendment of the plaint claimed relief for confirmation of possession along with declaration of title but did not put in requisite court fees for the relief of confirmation of possession.
